description:
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary for {R/G}{R/G}.
Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, triggering itself twice and Impact Tremors twice.
Resolve both Burning-Tree Emissary triggers, adding {R}{R}{G}{G}.
Resolve both Impact Tremors triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Burning-Tree Emissary to your hand.
Repeat.
